hypothesis: The frozen disjoint 110-event cohort retains enough complete and non-stale 18-hour Polymarket probability vectors for a balanced temporal 07Z-versus-13Z comparison.

join_contract.market_vector: latest valid point at or before cutoff for every YES bucket; preserve raw values and normalize only downstream

price_history.point_rule: latest valid point at or before end_date_utc minus 18 hours; post-cutoff points forbidden

decision_rule.pass: Freeze immutable price responses and separately preregister two-cycle NBM collection.
decision_rule.fail: Do not download the 20 NBM objects or fit a model; diagnose whether history retention or cohort balance is the limiting factor without changing this cohort's gates post hoc.
